title: Engineering Cybergenetic Cell-Based Therapies
authors: Chang C; Arampatzis A; Balula S; Hou M; Filo M; Chen M; Cella F; Khammash M
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦细胞治疗中的闭环控制工程，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Adaptive, closed-loop control of cellular behavior is essential for next-generation therapies, yet most current treatments operate in an open-loop manner and lack robustness to patient variability and disease dynamics. Here, we establish a controltheoretic platform for rational engineering of closed-loop cell-based therapies that achieve precise and robust regulation. First, we introduce multi-dimensional nullgram profiling, a high-throughput approach that enables quantitative prediction and design of advanced genetic controllers in human cells across circuit topologies and parameter regimes in a single experiment. To evaluate dynamic therapeutic behavior, we next develop Cyberpatient-in-the-loop, an optogenetic digital twin platform that interfaces engineered mammalian cells with computational disease models, enabling systematic testing of closed-loop performance under realistic perturbations. Finally, we leverage these approaches to implement integral feedback cell therapies that sense inflammatory signals and autonomously regulate cytokine levels in primary immune cell cultures. Together, these results establish a general paradigm for engineering cellbased control systems and provide a foundation for next-generation cell therapies.
abstract_zh: 细胞行为的自适应闭环控制对于下一代疗法至关重要，然而目前大多数治疗以开环方式运作，缺乏对患者变异性和疾病动态的鲁棒性。在此，我们建立了一个控制理论平台，用于合理工程化实现精确且稳健调控的闭环细胞疗法。首先，我们引入了多维零谱分析（multi-dimensional nullgram profiling），这是一种高通量方法，能够在单次实验中跨电路拓扑和参数范围，对人类细胞中的先进遗传控制器进行定量预测和设计。为了评估动态治疗行为，我们随后开发了“数字患者参与”（Cyberpatient-in-the-loop），这是一种光遗传学数字孪生平台，将工程化哺乳动物细胞与计算疾病模型相连接，能够在现实扰动下系统测试闭环性能。最后，我们利用这些方法实现了积分反馈细胞疗法，该疗法能够感知炎症信号并在原代免疫细胞培养中自主调节细胞因子水平。综合来看，这些结果确立了工程化细胞控制系统的一般范式，并为下一代细胞疗法奠定了基础。
